title: ParAnimator configuration
description: Describes one animation render using an Id source par entry, output library files, and animated parameter tracks.

parameter-catalogs.description: Parameter catalog JSON files used to validate and resolve track targets.

items.description: Catalog filename or path read by ParAnimator.

source.description: Source Id par entry used as the base frame state.

name.description: Source entry name inside the source par file.

output.description: Generated output locations and names for Id library files and batch script.

directory.description: Output directory containing generated par, map, image, and script files.

par.description: Generated par filename written under the output par directory.

parallel.description: Optional number of Id render commands to run in parallel.

video.description: Id video mode used for generated render commands.

num-frames.description: Number of animation frames to generate.

tracks.description: Animated parameter tracks applied to the source par entry.

items.description: One animated parameter target and its value source.

oneOf.description: Track that writes generated Id map files and emits colors=@filename.

track-format.description: Output value format used by a virtual track.

oneOf.description: Emit an Id at-file reference such as @colors-0001.map.

track-mode.description: Alternate evaluation mode for a track.

oneOf.description: Pulse-width modulation between two explicit discrete values.

value-track.description: Parameter track defined by keyed values or a path generator.

oneOf.description: Value track defined by explicit keyframes.
Value track defined by a path generator.

parameter.description: Catalog parameter key, fractal params key, or formula metadata key to animate.

keys.description: Exactly two keyframes defining the animated value segment.

path.description: Path generator that produces full-range keyframes for this track.

path-generator.description: Full-range value generator used instead of explicit keyframes.

constant-path-generator.description: Path generator that emits one fixed value for every frame.

kind.description: Generate a full-range constant value path.

value.description: Parameter value text emitted for every frame.

line-path-generator.description: Path generator that linearly interpolates from one value to another.

kind.description: Generate a full-range linear value path.

from.description: Parameter value text at frame zero.

to.description: Parameter value text at the final frame.

circle-path-generator.description: Path generator that samples a circle over the full frame range.

kind.description: Generate values on a circular path.

center.description: Path center as a slash-pair value.

radius.description: Circle radius in output value units.

turns.description: Number of complete turns sampled over the full frame range.

ellipse-path-generator.description: Path generator that samples an axis-aligned ellipse over the full frame range.

kind.description: Generate values on an axis-aligned elliptical path.

center.description: Path center as a slash-pair value.

x-radius.description: Ellipse radius along the first output component.

y-radius.description: Ellipse radius along the second output component.

turns.description: Number of complete turns sampled over the full frame range.

value-keyframe.description: One keyed parameter value at an animation frame.

frame.description: Zero-based frame index for this key.

value.description: Parameter value text in the format required by the target metadata.

curve.description: Optional interpolation curve override ending at this key.

pwm-track.description: Discrete track that temporally dithers between two explicit values.

parameter.description: Catalog parameter key, fractal params key, or formula metadata key to animate.

mode.description: Selects pulse-width modulation for this track.

a.description: Discrete value emitted when the evaluated mix selects the first endpoint.

b.description: Discrete value emitted when the evaluated mix selects the second endpoint.

window.description: Number of frames in each PWM decision window.

keys.description: Exactly two keyframes defining the animated mix segment.

pwm-keyframe.description: One keyed PWM mix value at an animation frame.

frame.description: Zero-based frame index for this key.

mix.description: Fraction of the PWM window assigned to value b.

color-map-track.description: Track that writes generated frame map files using keyed maps, source maps, or generated sources.

oneOf.description: Color-map shorthand that interpolates between keyed source map files.
Color-map track that starts from one file or generated source.

parameter.description: Id parameter to receive the generated at-file map reference.

type.description: Selects color-map side-file generation for this track.

format.description: Format for the generated Id parameter value.

output.description: Generated map filename pattern written under the output map directory.

keys.description: Exactly two keyframes selecting source map files.

source.description: Source Id map file or generated source read before applying ordered effects.

effects.description: Ordered color-map effects applied to the source map.

color-map-source.description: Source used to produce a frame color map before effects.

oneOf.description: Source Id map file read from disk.
Generated gradient source object.

gradient-color-map-source.description: Generated color map made from indexed color stops.

kind.description: Generate a color map by interpolating indexed color stops.

stops.description: Color stops sorted by palette index.

gradient-color-map-stop.description: One indexed color stop in a generated gradient map.

index.description: Palette index for this color stop.

color.description: Color specification used at this palette index.

color-specification.description: Concrete color written as a CSS named color, RGB tuple, HSV tuple, or HSL tuple.

oneOf.description: CSS named color, case-insensitive; accepted names are checked against the W3C CSS Color Module Level 4 named-colors table.
RGB slash tuple, with optional rgb: prefix and integer components from 0 through 255.
HSV slash tuple with hue from 0 through 360 and saturation/value from 0 through 1.
HSL slash tuple with hue from 0 through 360 and saturation/lightness from 0 through 1.

color-map-effect.description: One transformation applied to a color map.

brightness-color-map-effect.description: Effect that scales every RGB component by a keyed amount.

kind.description: Scale RGB components by a keyed amount.

contrast-color-map-effect.description: Effect that scales RGB component distance from midgray.

kind.description: Scale RGB component distance from midgray.

gamma-color-map-effect.description: Effect that applies nonlinear intensity shaping.

hue-shift-color-map-effect.description: Effect that rotates color hue in HSL space.

kind.description: Rotate color hue by keyed degrees.

mask-blend-color-map-effect.description: Effect that blends selected ranges with another Id map file.

kind.description: Blend selected ranges with another Id map file.

ranges.description: Inclusive palette index ranges to blend.

source.description: Source Id map file used for blended entries.

pulse-color-map-effect.description: Effect that blends one range toward a concrete color.

kind.description: Blend one range toward a concrete color.

range.description: Inclusive palette index range to pulse.

remap-color-map-effect.description: Effect that reindexes the map with a 256-entry lookup table.

kind.description: Reindex the map with a 256-entry lookup table.

reverse-color-map-effect.description: Effect that reverses a full color map or one inclusive range.

range.description: Optional inclusive palette index range to reverse.

saturation-color-map-effect.description: Effect that scales color saturation in HSL space.

kind.description: Scale color saturation by a keyed amount.

sparkle-color-map-effect.description: Effect that applies seeded random color perturbation in one range.

kind.description: Apply seeded random color perturbation in one range.

range.description: Inclusive palette index range to perturb.

seed.description: Integer seed for repeatable random perturbation.

amount.description: Keyed maximum component delta from 0 through 255.

ping-pong-color-map-effect.description: Effect that rotates entries forward, then backward, over a ping-pong cycle.

range.description: Optional inclusive palette index range to ping-pong.

offset.description: Keyed numeric offset sampled before ping-pong wrapping.

color-map-ranges.description: One or more inclusive color-map palette index ranges.

color-map-remap-indices.description: Destination-indexed table of source palette indices.

unit-number-track.description: Keyed numeric effect parameter from 0 through 1.

keys.description: Exactly two keyed numeric values from 0 through 1.

unit-number-keyframe.description: One keyed numeric value from 0 through 1.

frame.description: Zero-based frame index for this unit numeric key.

value.description: Numeric value sampled at this keyframe.

curve.description: Optional interpolation curve ending at this unit numeric key.

byte-number-track.description: Keyed numeric effect parameter from 0 through 255.

keys.description: Exactly two keyed numeric values from 0 through 255.

byte-number-keyframe.description: One keyed numeric value from 0 through 255.

frame.description: Zero-based frame index for this byte numeric key.

value.description: Numeric value sampled at this keyframe.

curve.description: Optional interpolation curve ending at this byte numeric key.

keys.description: Exactly two keyed positive numeric values.

positive-number-keyframe.description: One keyed positive numeric value at an animation frame.

frame.description: Zero-based frame index for this positive numeric key.

value.description: Positive numeric value sampled at this keyframe.

curve.description: Optional interpolation curve ending at this positive numeric key.

number-keyframe.description: One keyed numeric value at an animation frame.

frame.description: Zero-based frame index for this numeric key.

value.description: Numeric value sampled at this keyframe.

curve.description: Optional interpolation curve ending at this numeric key.

scalar-curve.description: Interpolation curve used for keyed scalar effect parameters.
